run_groups.pass1_superseded: r0003-r0044 (absolute-pad segment enclosure; valid but loose on P4)

key_findings: Arb evaluation with rigorous inputs reproduces the float probe of 2026-10-08 to 6 decimals on all 14 rows; 0 violations.
N3x as a rigorous upper Riemann sum (Taylor segment enclosures, M-matrix LU) sits 0.6-5.5 orders above S and at most 2.0 above the exact-mass floor; MR3 closed before 2026-10-15.
Rate shares reproduce opportunities.md within 1 point; N3x captures 0.98-0.99 of the exact rate against 0.05-0.17 for Sigma1.
summary.interpretation: All four plan hypotheses supported in the final pass; hypothesis 2 was refuted in pass 1 by an enclosure that destroyed the door factor on P4, fixed before the final pass. N3x is a per-instance computer-assisted certificate from block data, not a closed-form bound.
